elements.name: Capricorn
elements.text: Capricorn: disciplined, earthy ambition, limits and responsibility built through hard work.

elements.name: Horns
elements.text: The goat horns crowning him: Pan's wild, chthonic form, the primordial instinct this card doesn't condemn so much as ask us to own.

elements.name: Loose chains
elements.text: The chain trailing loose from each figure's neck into the flames, never pulled taut: bondage that could be shrugged off at any time, the freedom of choice already in their own hands.
